# Fixture T25: research required

Synthetic case. Ridgeway Joinery, its site, people, figures and dates are invented. They are not a real business or real search data.

## Request

"We want more wardrobe jobs this summer. Where should SEO focus first?"

## Business record

Supplied by the owner on 18 Nov 2026. Not independently checked.

- Ridgeway Joinery, `https://ridgewayjoinery.example/`, a custom joinery workshop in Moonah, Hobart, Tasmania. The owner and two cabinetmakers.
- Offers: custom kitchens, built-in wardrobes and laundry cabinetry. Not offered: flat-pack, bathroom renovations, commercial fit-outs.
- Door-only wardrobe work: the workshop has replaced sliding doors on a few wardrobes it built for past clients. The owner has not decided whether to offer door-only replacement to new customers, and has no price guide for it.
- Capacity: kitchens are booked about 10 weeks ahead. Wardrobes have spare capacity.
- Coverage: installs within about 40 minutes' drive of the workshop.
- Audience: homeowners renovating or building.
- Outcome: qualified quote requests, marked by the owner in the quote log.
- Delivery: WordPress with a page builder. A web contractor edits pages, with about 6 hours a month available. The owner approves page changes before they go live.
- Evidence the business holds: photos of 14 new wardrobe jobs with client permission to publish, and a price-range guide for new wardrobes.

| ID | Source | Period and settings |

## Figures as supplied

- E1: wardrobe-related queries fall into two groups, summed by the user. New built-in wardrobes ("built in wardrobes hobart", "custom wardrobes hobart"): 800 impressions, 14 clicks. Replacement doors ("sliding wardrobe doors hobart", "replace wardrobe doors", "mirror wardrobe doors"): 1,900 impressions, 21 clicks. Both groups are mostly attributed to the home page. The `/wardrobes/` page row: 410 impressions, 6 clicks.
- E3: 29 quote requests, 21 qualified. Wardrobe requests: 4 for new wardrobes, 3 asking for door-only replacement (marked not qualified because the offer is undecided).
- E4: test submissions from the wardrobe, kitchen and contact forms all arrived and appear in E3.
- E5: `/wardrobes/` describes custom built-in wardrobes only, in about 120 words, with no photos, prices or lead times. It does not mention doors or replacements.
- E6: 9 callers asked about replacing sliding or mirrored doors on an existing wardrobe; 6 asked about the price of new built-in wardrobes; 5 asked about lead times.
- E7: for "sliding wardrobe doors hobart", the first results were door suppliers' product pages and two hardware retailers' category pages. For "built in wardrobes hobart", the first results were local joinery service pages with project photos and price guidance.
